scope: Public-safe audience, pain, solution and reason briefs for the ten-card slate

briefs.audience: People responsible for AI in small businesses
briefs.pain: A repeated weekly update is rebuilt without a clear source, reviewer or failure check
briefs.solution: Map one ordinary task from facts through review and sending, with a named owner at each step
briefs.reason: The concrete task and unknown-date check make safe testing inspectable.

briefs.pain: A draft can turn an unconfirmed delivery date into a promise
briefs.solution: Keep source messages beside editable drafts and route missing facts to the person who can approve them
briefs.reason: The fact-to-promise boundary is immediately visible.

briefs.pain: A tool purchase starts before the required job and human check are defined
briefs.solution: State one job, one check and one missing fact the test must expose before subscribing
briefs.reason: The policy fixture turns a generic buying decision into a bounded test.

briefs.audience: Teams turning enquiry notes into follow-up drafts
briefs.pain: Conflicting or missing dates can be silently resolved by a draft
briefs.solution: Use fictional notes, preserve conflicts and require a reviewer decision before sending
briefs.reason: The Tuesday/Thursday conflict makes the failure case concrete.

briefs.pain: A reminder can state a date without telling the customer how to request a change
briefs.solution: Show the appointment, the change route and the responsible handoff while keeping sending separate
briefs.reason: The recipient and reception role are explicit in the same test.

briefs.pain: A demo can force an unclear reply into a confirmed booking
briefs.solution: Keep the uncertain reply visible and let the draft ask the question a person must confirm
briefs.reason: The exception path is treated as a real workflow branch.

briefs.pain: A view count does not explain which customer question matters
briefs.solution: Inspect the question behind the post, then write an original version using the team’s own process and check
briefs.reason: The metric stays an observation while the task returns to customer need.

briefs.pain: Many updates obscure the decision, owner and source that matter
briefs.solution: Sort notes into changed, decision needed and wait, then name the owner and source
briefs.reason: The brief supports a human decision without making it for them.

briefs.pain: A polished demo can hide access, cost, maintenance and responsibility questions
briefs.solution: Test one awkward case and keep the open operating questions visible
briefs.reason: A small test answers a small question while preserving unresolved risk.

briefs.audience: Teams comparing AI tools for operational work
briefs.pain: Shortlists often omit how the team will detect and fix a wrong answer
briefs.solution: Compare the same input with failure, detection method and repair owner columns
briefs.reason: The failure-column method makes correction work part of the decision.

limits: These briefs summarize editorial intent only. They do not establish market demand, performance, trend validity, owner footage, recorded speech or production readiness.
